BC_description: Renamed the 'signal' option to 'cancelSignal' in execa method calls. Passing the 'signal' option will now throw an error.
Adaptation_method: Change 'signal' to 'cancelSignal' in the options object for execa calls. Example: await execa('node', ['file.js'], { cancelSignal: abortController.signal }); // Instead of { signal: abortController.signal }
